## What is a virtual office in ADGM?

A virtual office in ADGM is a registered office address inside the Abu Dhabi Global Market jurisdiction that a company can use for ADGM company registration, licence renewals, letterheads and official mail, without renting a full-time office. Mail handling and on-demand meeting rooms are usually included.

## Mail handling

1. Mail arrives at Addax Tower — Letters and parcels addressed to your company are received at our staffed reception on the 38th floor.
2. Held for you — Your mail stays with our reception team until you collect it or ask us to forward it.
3. Forward or collect — Collect it in person, or have it forwarded — worldwide mail forwarding is available.
4. Calls answered too — Premium and Enterprise add live call answering in your company name on a UAE number.

## Frequently asked questions

### How much does a virtual office in ADGM cost?

A virtual office at Aegis Coworking in ADGM starts from AED 292 per month (regular price AED 350). That is the Basic package with a registered ADGM business address, mail handling and directory listing. Premium and Enterprise packages add a UAE phone line, call answering, meeting room access and account management — ask us for a quote.

Read more: [ADGM coworking and office cost guide 2026](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/adgm-coworking-space-cost-2026)

### What is a virtual office in ADGM?

A virtual office in ADGM gives your company a registered office address inside the Abu Dhabi Global Market jurisdiction, plus mail handling and on-demand meeting rooms, without renting a full-time office. At Aegis Coworking the address is Office 3812, Addax Tower, Al Reem Island.

Read more: [Virtual office ADGM explained](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/virtual-office-adgm-your-prestigious-business-address-minus-the-cost)

### Can I use the virtual office address for ADGM company registration?

Yes. The Aegis virtual office address can be used for initial ADGM company registration and for ongoing licence renewals, and we support you through the ADGM licence application.

### Do I need a physical office, or is a virtual office enough in ADGM?

Many non-regulated ADGM companies can use a virtual office or flexi desk. FSRA-regulated firms usually need physical premises, such as a serviced private office. Check your licence type before choosing.

Read more: [ADGM FSRA office requirements](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/adgm-fsra-office-requirements)

### What is included in the virtual office packages?

Basic includes a registered ADGM business address, licence application support, mail receiving and forwarding and a company directory listing. Premium adds a UAE business phone number with live call answering, meeting room access and priority mail handling. Enterprise adds a dedicated account manager, priority administrative support and flexible coworking access.

### Is mail handling included with the virtual office?

Yes. Every package includes mail receiving and forwarding at Addax Tower, with worldwide forwarding available. Premium includes priority mail handling.

### Does the virtual office include meeting room access?

Meeting room access is included in the Premium and Enterprise packages. Basic members can book meeting rooms by the hour when they need to meet clients in Abu Dhabi.

### Is Addax Tower on Al Reem Island inside ADGM?

Yes. Addax Tower on Al Reem Island is within the ADGM jurisdiction, so an Addax Tower business address is a genuine ADGM business address.

Read more: [Is Al Reem Island part of ADGM?](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/is-al-reem-island-part-of-adgm)

### Can I register an ADGM company from abroad with a virtual office?

Many international founders set up remotely and use a virtual office for the ADGM company address. See how remote registration works before you start.

Read more: [Registering an ADGM company remotely](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/adgm-company-registration-remote-uae)

### Can two companies share one virtual office address?

Each ADGM company needs its own registered address arrangement. Ask us about setups for more than one company.

Read more: [Can two ADGM companies share a registered address?](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/adgm-shared-registered-address-multiple-companies)

### What is a serviced office or executive office in ADGM?

A serviced office is a fully furnished private office with internet, cleaning, reception and utilities included in one monthly price. At Aegis, serviced and executive offices on Al Reem Island start from AED 4,500 per month for teams of 1 to 20+, with 24/7 access and a registered ADGM business address.

Read more: [Private office rent in ADGM: 2026 guide](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/private-office-rent-adgm-cost-what-to-expect-in-2026)

### Can I upgrade from a virtual office to a desk or serviced office later?

Yes. You can move from a virtual office to a dedicated desk or a private serviced office at Addax Tower at any time, at preferential rates.

### Can I run my ADGM company from home with a virtual office?

Many founders keep the virtual office as their registered ADGM address and work from home. Your licence obligations still apply, so read our guide first.

Read more: [Running your ADGM company from home](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/adgm-work-from-home-registered-address)

### How do I get started?

Message us on WhatsApp or call +971 50 392 6316. Tours of Addax Tower run Monday to Friday, 9 AM–6 PM, and we can send a video walkthrough if you are abroad.
